subject: Re: Voice message: quotation request from Weidner Spielwaren GmbH
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for getting back to me! Yes, please go ahead with the quote for LIM and look for the most economical routing.

We have 11 pieces of textile samples, 1,804 kg gross and 17.18 cbm in total. They’ll be ready for pickup on 24 November 2026 at our site in 51943, Germany. Please include trucking from our site to the airport. I’ll check the full pickup address and get back to you.

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg
